record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare STUFF_CHEEKS: Skwovet (1 star) and Greedent (2 stars), both maxPP 100, range 1, no passive. Units are bound by the queue record only.
record.summary: Self-targeted berry ability with two branches. (1) If the caster holds at least one berry (any of the 24 in Berries, special ones included), one held berry is picked uniformly at random and eaten immediately through eatBerry(berry, undefined, healToShield = true, apScaling = 1, crit): every heal(val) in that berry's effect is turned into addShield(val, caster, apBoost 1, crit), so the requested heal amount becomes a requested SHIELD (Big Eater Belt x1.25 down on the request, then x(1 + AP/100), x critPower on a crit, x0.5 when enraged, rounded). The berry's other effects (stat gains, immunities, statuses, protect, gold and similar rewards) still happen unchanged; the berry is then removed (also from the permanent board unit). (2) If it holds no berry, it forages one random berry from the 20 non-special berries and equips it with addItem(berry, true) (nothing happens if it already holds 3 items); that berry is not eaten now and behaves like any held berry afterwards (eaten as a normal heal when the unit takes damage below 50 % HP). The strategy ignores its cast target; requiresTarget stays true.

targeting.note: The target parameter is passed to super.process only (animation); requiresTarget keeps the base default true, so the unit must have a target to cast.

requestedAmountByBerry.ORAN_BERRY: 50 through heal() plus a separate addShield(80, apBoost 0) that is not AP-scaled and not crit-scaled

effects.scaling: requested = the berry's heal amount (table above, shared with eatBerry's normal path) passed to addShield(val, caster, 1, crit). entity addShield first applies Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down, holder only); the state's addShield then needs hp > 0, multiplies by (1 + AP/100), by critPower if crit, by 0.5 when the unit is enraged and the value is positive, rounds, and sets shield = max(0, shield + value); shieldDone is credited to the caster. The cast crits only with ABILITY_CRIT (canCritByDefault is false). Because the amount goes through addShield and not handleHeal, wound, status.protect and the missing-HP cap do not apply and there is no overheal to max HP (core-mechanics section J4); no HP is healed by this path. Rune Protect has no effect on it. The separate Oran shield of 80 uses apBoost 0 and crit false, so only Big Eater Belt and the enraged halving change it.
effects.resolution: requested heal amount -> downstream request after Big Eater Belt -> final shield after AP, crit, enraged halving and rounding; takenDamage is not involved. The picked berry is random, so which row applies is not predictable.

effects.target: caster (and its player for the special berries)

declaredRaw.note: the per-berry non-heal effects of eatBerry, unchanged by healToShield

effects.scaling: Stat gains (Attack, Defense, SpeDef, Speed, AP, crit chance, PP) are requested with apBoost 0 and crit false, so they do not scale with AP or the cast crit; statuses and immunities are set as in a normal berry (for example 3000 ms confusion for Aguav, Rune Protect 5000 ms and clearing negative status for Lum). Special berries also touch the player's gold, free rolls or items outside ghost battles. After the switch the berry is removed (stealedFrom is undefined), GLUTTON passive would add max HP (the listed units have no passive), BERRY_JUICE adds a 100 shield (apBoost 0) and OVERGROW adds 50 AP.
effects.resolution: requested -> applied by each stat helper (Big Eater Belt and Twist Band apply inside the adders); the exact per-berry stat table is eatBerry's and is not duplicated here beyond the cited cases

effects.scaling: no amount. A random non-special berry is added with addItem(berry, true): nothing happens when the unit already has 3 or more items; otherwise the item is added, applyItemEffect runs, and (not for ghost opponents, and only with fewer than 3 items on the board unit) the berry is also added to the board unit permanently. The berry is not eaten now: the ordinary trigger eats a held berry when damage is taken at HP below 50 % of max HP (a heal, not a shield).
effects.resolution: no berry eaten; equip may silently fail at 3 items

shields.raw: the picked berry's heal amount, converted to a requested shield with apBoost 1 (see effects.0); Oran adds a further requested 80 with apBoost 0

starBehavior.note: nothing in the strategy depends on stars; the amounts come from the berry. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None. The branch depends on the items currently held, not on position.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Each cast consumes at most one berry. With no berry the next cast forages one more (if there is a free item slot), so the sequence is forage, then eat on the following cast unless the foraged berry was already eaten by the normal low-HP trigger. No stored mode.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: the berry's heal amount as a shield (50 by default, 100 for Sitrus and Pecha, max(50, 0.5 x maxHP) for Aguav and the golden berries, Oran 50 + a separate 80). Downstream: Big Eater Belt x1.25 down, then x(1 + AP/100), x critPower on a crit, x0.5 if enraged, rounded; final shield = max(0, shield + value) with no cap and no wound or Protect check. The berry's stat gains use apBoost 0. In the forage branch nothing is requested; the item may not be added when the unit holds 3 items.
